2023-10-17-deans.en: The minutes contradict themselves on this vote. The roll call reads "Roll Call Vote: Jean - Yes, Joseph - Yes, Smith - Yes, Smukler - Yes, Fleurimond - Yes, Chernoff - Yes", but the next line reads "MOTION PASSED 5-1 with Commissioner Jean opposed." Commissioner Jean's vote is shown as not given.
2023-10-17-deans.es: El acta se contradice en esta votación. La votación nominal dice "Roll Call Vote: Jean - Yes, Joseph - Yes, Smith - Yes, Smukler - Yes, Fleurimond - Yes, Chernoff - Yes" (todos a favor), pero la línea siguiente dice "MOTION PASSED 5-1 with Commissioner Jean opposed." (aprobada 5-1 con la comisionada Jean en contra). El voto de la comisionada Jean aparece como no indicado.
2023-10-17-deans.ht: Rapò reyinyon an kontredi tèt li sou vòt sa a. Vòt nominal la di "Roll Call Vote: Jean - Yes, Joseph - Yes, Smith - Yes, Smukler - Yes, Fleurimond - Yes, Chernoff - Yes" (tout vote wi), men liy ki vin apre a di "MOTION PASSED 5-1 with Commissioner Jean opposed." (pase 5-1, komisyonè Jean te kont). Nou montre vòt komisyonè Jean kòm pa bay.
